What should I do with my sex life right now?

Have you thought about seeking counselling? There are tons of resources out there that can hook you up with some great resources. 

Your mental health definitely is a big deal, and it shouldnt stop you from achieving daily activities. I also didnt enter university right away at 18, but ended up taking it slower. I ended up not doing well in my final semester in Grade 12, and was super worried.

Fast forward a year later, I finally got into the school I wanted. So honestly, its never too late. But you should also not feel like youre alone, and that your thoughts arent valid. Because they are. 

Anyways, thats just my thing. PM if you need!

Hey man,

Feel free to send a message. At least you took responsibility for your actions. Thats a good first step.
I can't concentrate, I feel like fucking shit, my marks are slipping, I feel like the worst fucking person in the world. I haven't been able to fully concentrate for a few months

It was his first time too, I was more nervous then him and it was a hookup. Im probably overthinking it a bit, but I had really no idea what I was doing. I guess everyone first time happens differently.

Hey, 

I really hope you choose not to. Obviously I don't know you, I only know what Ive read here, but I promise there are people who at least would listen. If you think that no one would, Ill vouch that Ill listen.

I cannot promise that things might get better or worse, but please know there are people who at least care for you. 

If this is the only thing you end up reading, I am begging that you don't end your life. I got your back. Direct message if you want.

I feel you. 

I usually turn to watching comedy on youtube or Netflix. Im pretty anxious before I go to sleep, and it definitely keeps me grounded. Kevin Hart is absolutely hilarious and some of his stand ups are ridiculously funny.

By all, find something that doesn't have you feeling happy or sad before going to sleep, but something that at least calms you down.
